summary: Strengthen payroll calculations, controls, and audit evidence in five practical days. Review the course outline and plan your training.
lede: Payroll management training covers accurate gross-to-net calculations, payroll controls, and documentation of review decisions. Designed for payroll analysts, supervisors, and finance professionals, it provides practical methods to validate employee and time data, review deductions against applicable rules, reconcile payroll registers with payment summaries or ledgers, and record exceptions using checklists, reconciliation schedules, and control matrices.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who process, review, control, or report payroll and need practical methods for accurate calculations and compliance evidence. This course is designed for: Payroll Administrator: validates employee changes, time records, and payroll inputs. Payroll Analyst: investigates gross-to-net variances and prepares payroll reconciliations. Payroll Supervisor: reviews payroll registers, approvals, and exception resolution. Payroll Compliance Specialist: tracks statutory deduction changes and maintains compliance evidence. Payroll Systems Analyst: monitors payroll interfaces, access roles, and processing exceptions. Compensation and Benefits Analyst: checks pay components and employee benefit data. HR Operations Specialist: submits employee lifecycle changes that affect payroll. Finance Controller: reviews payroll-to-ledger reconciliations and period-end balances. Internal Auditor: tests payroll controls, approvals, and audit trails. Shared Services Manager: oversees payroll processing quality, service measures, and escalations.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with payroll processing, employee pay records, or payroll-related finance controls is recommended. You should be able to use basic spreadsheet functions; programming is not required. Examples use sample data and do not replace review of the employment, tax, and social contribution rules applicable to your organization.
